# Tutorial: Starting nuclear missiles (better) (atomic bomb / nuke)

![Tutorial: Starting nuclear missiles (better) (atomic bomb / nuke)](/uploads/48_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Here are a few tips on how best to ignite nukes with a new character and how you can get through the silos better with your existing character.

## NECESSARY QUESTS

In order to even get into the silos, you have to have completed a few important enclave quests. You don't have to do everything. You start with the quest "Bunker Breaker", which you trigger in the "**Abandoned Landfill**" (Northeast of Harper's Ferry). You complete this quest and continue following the quest series with the quests: "One of Us", "Officer on Deck" and "I Am Death".

## PREPARATION

In order to successfully get through the Alpha, Bravo and Charlie silos, you should keep a few things in mind.

- 
Have **nuclear missile key card** ready (under Miscellaneous)
- 
**Have the start code available** (The start codes change every week on Tuesday night around 1 a.m.), you can find the current codes in the header above this article.
(Alternatively, you can also search for the Burnt Officers using the code snippets and decipher the code yourself.)
- 
There are **only robots** in the silo. This means you should be prepared to deal well with Mr Gutsys, Robobrains, Sentry Bots and Aggressotrons at a high level. I especially recommend full “**The Problem Solver**” armor. The armor avoids 75% of damage from robots. In this context, selecting “Adamantium Skeleton” under Endurance can’t hurt either. A good weapon, for example, is an Explo Cleaner/Handmade, but even with a melee weapon this is no problem with problem-solver armor. Use what you get along with best. "The Problem Solver" weapons only make sense for Full Life players, as the +50% buff against robots is significantly less than a Bloodstained weapon on Bloodstained players (up to +80% on everything, at 20% HP).
Of course, you can also simply play with Unyielding or other armor if the change is too complicated for you; the protection is of course not that good if you are discovered.
- 
To save time, you should have the **Perks** "Burglar", "Professional Burglar", "Master Burglar" as well as "Hacker", "Professional Hacker" and "Master Hacker" ready and equipped. Or the legendary perk "Master Infiltrator", which can replace these perk cards.
- 
There is **high radiation** in the reactor room, so you should prepare accordingly. To do this, you can either put on power armor, or you can use RadShield or Rad-Away or Rad-Away diluted on the quick key, for example.
- 
To save more time, you can always have 15 repaired **central computer cores** with you, which you can exchange for the broken ones. But this is only possible from the 2nd silo run. Unfortunately, the central computer cores are now very heavy, so repairs in the silo are more advisable. For repairs you will find a room with a craft workbench in a side room opposite the door with the central computer cores.

## SILO RUN PROCESS

- 
**Check whether the silos are free** . In the quest "I am Death" you received a new, very useful holotape: "Rocket Status Holotape". You start this holotape in Pipboy and check the status of the silos. If it says “Startup preparation required” you can get started. If it says "Rocket instantiation active", the silo is closed and in "cool-down".
 (**Note**: There is also a personal invisible 3-hour cool-down for a silo that is not displayed in the holoband. If you have detonated a nuclear missile, this character cannot start a new one on other servers for 3 hours.)
